# iam314 — Lyudmil Dachev

> Lyudmil Dachev is a brand identity designer, artist and printmaker based in Sofia, Bulgaria. He designs visual identities and websites for founder-led businesses, and makes limited edition screen prints, fine art giclée prints and typefaces under his own name.

iam314 is the independent design practice of Lyudmil Dachev. Work covers brand identity and visual identity systems, logo design, art direction, UI/UX and web design, and development in Webflow and Shopify. Alongside client work he publishes a small catalogue of prints, type and icons sold direct. All work is made in Sofia and shipped worldwide.

## Practice

- [iam314](https://www.iam314.com/): Brand identity design, web design and development by Lyudmil Dachev.
- [Work](https://www.iam314.com/work/): Selected brand identity, web and product design case studies.
- [Marks](https://www.iam314.com/work/marks/): A curated collection of logo marks and brand symbols from a solo practice.
- [Crazy Frog](https://www.iam314.com/work/crazy-frog/): Brand identity and custom Shopify theme for a children's clothing retailer.
- [The R&B Awards](https://www.iam314.com/work/the-rnb-awards/): Brand identity and Webflow website for a music awards show.
- [Brand Springboard](https://www.iam314.com/work/brand-springboard/): Brand identity and website for a marketing company.
- [Contact](https://www.iam314.com/contact/): Enquiries about design work.

## Prints, type and icons

- [Store](https://www.iam314.com/store/): Limited edition prints, typefaces and icon sets, sold direct.
- [Stray](https://www.iam314.com/store/stray-print/): Fine art giclée print on Hahnemühle Photo Rag paper, 30 × 40 cm, hand-signed.
- [The kiss](https://www.iam314.com/store/kiss-print/): Hand-pulled screen print, limited edition of 9, 40 × 50 cm. Sold out.
- [The horizon](https://www.iam314.com/store/horizon-print/): Hand-pulled screen print, limited edition of 5, 25 × 17.5 cm.
- [314 bits](https://www.iam314.com/store/314bits-font/): A geometric display typeface, 575 glyphs across three weights.
- [Flag icons](https://www.iam314.com/store/flag-icons/): 112 minimal flag icons plus 15 Lottie animations.

## Usage

Artwork, photography and writing are © Lyudmil Dachev unless credited otherwise. Quoting, summarising and linking with attribution is welcome. Please do not use the artwork to train generative image models, and do not reproduce images as if they were your own.

Shipping times, returns and refunds are described on any store page under Shipping, Returns and Refunds.
